Priya (CS): Hey all — kickoff for Helios Furnishings onboarding. Quick sync to lock owners, measurable success criteria, and a compact 30/60/90 timeline.
Carlos (Helios Furnishings): Hi team 1 Carlos here. We'll own business approval and provide product taxonomy.
Priya (CS): Proposed owners list:
- Priya (CS): Program lead, enablement and feedback capture
- Ben (Solutions): Integration, test harness, infra templates
- Anya (PM): Acceptance testing & post-rollout QA
- Carlos (Helios): Business owner, taxonomy + user acceptance
Agree?
Ben (Solutions): Good for me. I'll aim to deliver a working smoke harness + sample data pipeline within 10 business days.
Anya (PM): I'll prepare acceptance tests focusing on classification accuracy + ingestion robustness.
Carlos (Helios Furnishings): We'll produce a 200-row sample CSV (sanitized) and expected labels by Thu.
Priya (CS): Draft success criteria suggestion:
1) Latency: p95 < 750ms for typical product lookup flows (Dedicated)
2) Accuracy: macro-F1 >= 0.85 on category mapping tests
3) Reliability: no P1 incidents during pilot (3-week pilot)
4) Enablement: two internal engineers can run end-to-end demo by day 14
5) Cost: average inference cost <= $0.005 for pilot volume
Please comment.
Ben (Solutions): Latency target seems fine but leaving headroom for longer sequences. Suggest fallback routing if p95 drifts > 20%.
Priya (CS): Noted 1 will add fallback policy to acceptance doc (route to quantized variant, degrade certain non-critical fields).
Anya (PM): Add instrumentation requirement: Redwood Console dashboards + a small eval job that runs nightly to catch regressions.
Priya (CS): Will do. Also proposing engagement cadence: weekly 30-min sync + biweekly stakeholder readout.
Carlos (Helios Furnishings): Weekly sync works. For procurement: renewal review at month 10. If unit cost > target by then, we need to present Optimize recommendations.
Ben (Solutions): On infra: prefer ephemeral credentials and S3 pre-signed URLs for uploads. Sample ingest script I will provide: 
```
# sample ingest for onboarding
aws s3 cp samples.csv s3://helios-onboard/samples.csv --profile helm-staging
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/evals 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-v2","eval_set":"s3://helios-onboard/samples.csv"}'
```
Priya (CS): Thanks. Ops note: retention policy for Dedicated onboarding artifacts is 45 days by default. Will confirm if Helios needs longer.
Carlos (Helios Furnishings): 45 days okay to start. Procurement may ask for 90-day retention later.
Anya (PM): Proposed 30/60/90 milestones (condensed):
- Day 0-30: sample ingestion, smoke harness, first eval, enablement workshop
- Day 31-60: pilot (3 stores), performance tuning, observability wired, cost report v1
- Day 61-90: broaden rollout to 12 stores, stability window, renewal prep docs
Priya (CS): Scheduling: enablement workshop week 2, 60-min remote. Suggested agenda: SDK quickstart, evals runbook, Console dashboards, Q&A. Carlos, can you nominate two engineers to attend?
Carlos (Helios Furnishings): I'll confirm names by EOD.
Ben (Solutions): Small perf risk: if peak traffic pattern includes many long prompts, we may hit token limits. Mitigation: prefix caching + bounded truncation.
Priya (CS): Adding to risks list: PII/legal clearance for sample data; procurement cost target; long-prompt latency; need for custom fine-tune. Please react to confirm or add.
Carlos (Helios Furnishings): :+1: on risks. Legal will review samples before Wed.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Helios Furnishings 1 Redwood Onboarding Workshop" Tue 10:00 PT 1 attendees: Priya, Ben, Anya, Carlos
Priya (CS): Quick request: Carlos, please upload sanitized CSV to the shared S3 bucket or provide pre-signed URL by Thu morning. Ben will validate ingestion.
Carlos (Helios Furnishings): Will upload and ping here.
Anya (PM): Acceptance checklist items I'll own: baseline eval, alerting thresholds, SLO doc.
Priya (CS): Feedback plan: short survey after workshop + a one-question weekly pulse in the sync. We'll capture NPS-ish responses and any blockers.
Ben (Solutions): I'll also prepare a short README for their repo with the quickstart snippet and troubleshooting notes.
Priya (CS): Risks summary captured in onboarding doc. Next steps: 
1) Carlos uploads sanitized samples (Thu)
2) Ben finishes ingest script + smoke run (within 10 bd)
3) Priya schedules workshop and publishes acceptance checklist (today)
4) Anya readies evaluation harness and dashboards (week 1)
Anything else?
Carlos (Helios Furnishings): All good. Thanks team 1 looking forward.
Priya (CS): Thanks everyone :wave: I'll post the onboarding checklist link after this thread and add the meeting notes to the shared folder.
